papers.title: Taming the Thinker: Conditional Entropy Shaping for Adaptive LLM Reasoning
papers.what: Uses token-level entropy to adaptively control reasoning depth during RL training, improving both accuracy and efficiency.

papers.title: Lance: Unified Multimodal Modeling by Multi-Task Synergy
papers.what: 3B-parameter unified model for image/video understanding, generation, and editing via dual-stream MoE.

papers.title: HodgeCover: Higher-Order Topological Coverage Drives Compression of Sparse MoE
papers.what: Uses Hodge decomposition to detect irreducible expert cycles that pairwise merging scores miss.

papers.title: Learning to Foresee: Unveiling the Unlocking Efficiency of On-Policy Distillation
papers.what: Explains why on-policy distillation works via early subspace alignment between current and final parameter updates.
